wrong_findings.claim: “both pages rank for the same four queries”
wrong_findings.why_wrong: The audit's own table shows no row for “pour over ratio” for the second page, so it does not show both ranking for all four queries.

wrong_findings.claim: “No page is blocked from indexing except the wholesale page.”
wrong_findings.why_wrong: The crawl marks `/shop/` Non-Indexable because it is canonicalised to `/coffee/`.

wrong_findings.claim: “Article markup exists on two of four posts.”
wrong_findings.why_wrong: Three posts have Article JSON-LD in their HTML: how-to-brew-pour-over, pour-over-coffee-guide, and best-coffee-beans-2024.

wrong_findings.claim: “The other product pages (Ijen, Bajawa) have no markup at all.”
wrong_findings.why_wrong: `/coffee/java-ijen/` has valid Product JSON-LD, including a `name` field.

extra_true.finding: The homepage and `/coffee/` link to Kintamani and Ijen but omit the live Flores Bajawa product.
`/visit/` has no map, photos, or local business structured data.
The site has no Open Graph or Twitter card tags.
The footer omits a phone number that appears on the contact page.
The brewing guide presents its grind size chart as a sentence rather than a table.

notes: All 20 planted issues are identified with the correct page or site file. Total is approximate and counts distinct actionable findings, excluding repeated mentions and general advice.
